BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, ʼethmôwl means heretofore. It turns up in 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, Isaiah, and Micah, and the sense holds steady from place to place. The word does quiet work, and the passages below show it in its ordinary setting.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: ʼethmôwl means what it says, and what it says matters. That is the sense I carry into the passages above.
RelatedEvents: David Becomes King; The Ark Captured and Returned
